trust_decision.summary: readRawBody decides whether the Node request carries a body from Content-Length / Transfer-Encoding; a case-sensitive exact-token match on 'chunked' makes h3 treat a mixed-case chunked request as bodiless while Node's parser still consumes it as chunked.

landing_point.why: The only Transfer-Encoding read in src; the advisory title names readRawBody and the TE.TE case mismatch.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API readRawBody(event) and its callers readBody / readValidatedBody / readMultipartFormData / proxyRequest (non-stream)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No uncovered site to dismiss; the only other body path (getRequestWebStream, src/utils/body.ts:318-330) streams unconditionally with no TE/CL decision, so it agrees with Node's parser.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A POST with neither Content-Length nor Transfer-Encoding must still resolve to undefined (not hang waiting on the stream); an over-broad fix that always reads the stream or treats any TE as chunked changes this.

O6_input_shapes: Transfer-Encoding value with mixed/upper case (Chunked, CHUNKED, ChunKed)
comma-list Transfer-Encoding (e.g. 'gzip, chunked') already handled by split at pinned commit and by \b regex after fix

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a 'has body?' short-circuit in getRequestWebStream reading transfer-encoding/content-length the same case-sensitive way before attaching node stream listeners
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: readRawBody already has this shortcut; a maintainer could copy it into the stream path to avoid creating empty streams for bodiless requests.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: proxyRequest deciding whether to forward a body by its own case-sensitive TE/CL inspection instead of delegating to readRawBody
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: proxyRequest already strips transfer-encoding (src/utils/proxy.ts:26) and picks body mode itself, so a local framing check is plausible.

O9_family: HTTP request smuggling / parser differential (CWE-444): case-sensitive Transfer-Encoding token match

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + pnpm@10.17.1, vitest, unbuild, tsc (package.json:22-33, package.json:76)
O10_build.project_tests: test/body.test.ts (readRawBody chunked / no-body cases at test/body.test.ts:58-95), run with vitest

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Lower-case the header value before the existing split/includes('chunked') check (correct and complete here).

out_of_scope_notes: Content-Length is interpreted via Number.parseInt (src/utils/body.ts:111), which accepts prefixes like '5abc'; not part of this advisory's TE case property.
unverified: repo_mb not measured; tiny_repo inferred from src/ containing ~43 TypeScript files.
Real-world smuggling impact depends on Node's llhttp handling TE case-insensitively (h3 vs Node disagree on body presence); not checked against Node sources.
present_in_latest not applicable (no latest release given; O8 empty).
